description: You're shown a historical photograph and must guess the year it was taken by placing a marker on a timeline. The closer your guess, the more points you score, across 5 photos.

name: Chordle
description: Guess the day's four-note seventh chord in 4 tries. Each guess must be a valid diatonic seventh chord; notes are scored Wordle-style — green for a right note in the right position, yellow for a right note in the wrong position, gray for absent — and you must match the correct inversion to win.

name: Chessle
description: Guess the day's chess opening — the sequence of moves for both White and Black — in 6 tries. Each guess is scored move by move: green for a move played in that exact spot, yellow for a move that occurs elsewhere in the sequence, gray for a move not played.

name: Chess.com Daily Puzzle
description: A chess position is set up with one side to move; find the winning tactic by playing the correct sequence of best moves. A new puzzle appears each day and they get harder through the week.

name: Chainagram
description: Build a chain that links a start word to an end word, where each 5-letter link is an anagram of the previous word with exactly one letter changed. Work out which letter to swap at each step to complete the chain.

name: CFBordle
description: Guess the day's 5-letter college football word in 6 tries. Each guess scores Wordle-style — green for a right letter in the right spot, yellow for a right letter in the wrong spot, gray for absent.

name: Cell Tower
description: Divide the whole grid into connected regions so that each region spells a 4-to-8-letter word read left to right, top to bottom. There is exactly one way to cover the grid completely in valid words. Tap cells to build a region, then confirm each word.

name: Capitale
description: Guess the mystery capital city. After each guess, hints compare it to the target — matching continent, relative population and area, plus the distance and compass direction to the real capital — until you name it.

name: Brickdle
description: A LEGO set is pictured with its name; guess how many pieces it contains. Each wrong guess tells you whether the real count is higher or lower, and you narrow in on the exact number in as few tries as possible.

name: BrainBashers Daily Puzzle
description: A different brain teaser every day — decode a hidden proverb, unscramble a word, or crack a number or logic riddle. Work out the day's solution, with an optional hint and the full answer available if you get stuck.

name: BrainBashers Daily 30 Seconds
description: Start from a given number, then apply a rapid chain of arithmetic instructions — halve, double, square, or take a fraction or percentage — one after another to reach the final answer, ideally within 30 seconds.

name: Boggdle
description: Form words by swiping across a grid of adjacent letters in any direction. Each tile carries a point value and words of 6 letters or more earn a bonus; your score is the total from your 3 best words. You start with 3 lives and lose one for each invalid word.

name: Balatrodle
description: Identify the day's Balatro joker card. Each guessed joker reveals how it compares on cost, ability, RNG, and scaling; matching attributes narrow the field, and the more you match, the more a hint about the name is revealed.

name: Artle
description: You're shown a work of art and must name the artist who created it. Each wrong guess reveals another of that artist's works, up to 4 in total.

name: Archiguessr
description: Identify the day's architectural project from a photo of it. Each wrong guess reveals another image of the same project, with a hint after 3 tries and 6 tries in total.

name: Antiwordle
description: The reverse of Wordle: stretch out guessing the hidden word for as many tries as possible. Letters not in the word gray out and can't be reused; letters that are in the word turn yellow and must be reused; letters in the exact spot turn red and lock in place.

name: Adoptle
description: A real adoptable shelter pet is pictured; guess its name in 6 tries. Each guess must be a valid word and is scored Wordle-style — green for a right letter in the right spot, yellow for a right letter in the wrong spot, gray for absent.

name: Actorle TV
description: Identify the mystery actor who appeared in all of the listed TV series. Each show starts hidden, showing only its year, genre, and episode count; each guessed actor narrows the field until you name the right one.

name: Actorle - Storyboard
description: Six shuffled screenshots from the day's movie are shown; drag and drop them into the order they appear in the film. Correctly placed frames lock in from the start, and you have 6 guesses to finish.

name: Actorle - Fill The Grid
description: Each cell of the grid sits where a column movie meets a row movie; fill it with an actor who appeared in both films. Complete every cell to finish the grid.

name: 23 Words
description: Rearrange all of the given letters into a valid word before the timer runs out. Clear 23 rounds in a row to win.

name: Rhyme Time
description: Work out a set of 3 words that all rhyme with one another. Fill in all three and submit; you have unlimited guesses, and there may be more than one valid solution. If stuck, reveal whether a chosen letter appears in the answer, but only one letter reveal per day.

name: relatle
description: Travel from a starting musical artist to a target artist by hopping through related artists. Each step, pick one of the shown related artists to move closer, and reach the target in as few steps as possible.

name: Redacle
description: A Wikipedia article has every word hidden. Guess words one at a time to reveal each place they appear, using the revealed structure as clues, and win by uncovering the article's title.

name: Quintessential
description: Rearrange a 5×5 grid of scrambled letters into 5 themed words by swapping pairs of tiles, in as few moves as possible. Green marks a correctly placed letter, yellow a letter in the right word but the wrong spot, gray a letter that belongs in a different word.

name: Primel
description: Guess the day's 5-digit prime number in 6 tries. Every guess must itself be a valid prime; digits then turn green for a correct digit in the right spot, yellow for one in the wrong spot, gray for absent.

name: Polygonle
description: A row of geometric symbols encodes a hidden word — matching symbols mark repeated letters, so the pattern shows which positions share a letter. Guess any word of the right length in 6 tries; tiles turn green for a correct letter in place, yellow for one in the wrong spot, gray for absent.

name: Phrasle
description: Uncover a hidden phrase by guessing its letters, hangman style. Each correct letter fills every spot it appears, and you have 5 misses before you lose; a hint reveals the phrase's category.

name: morsle
description: Decode a word played aloud in Morse code and type it within 21 tries. Playback starts fast at 40 words per minute and slows by 5 every 3 tries; correct letters lock in green.

name: MLB Pickle
description: Identify the mystery MLB player in 9 guesses. Each guess reveals how it compares on team, league, division, handedness, age and position — green marks an exact match, gold a near miss such as the right league or an age within 2 years.

name: Metazooa
description: Identify the hidden animal species within 20 guesses. Each guess reveals how closely it is related to the mystery animal on the taxonomic tree — sharing a genus, family, order, class or higher clade — so you narrow down the animal tree of life to zero in on the answer.

name: Metaflora
description: Identify the hidden plant species within 25 guesses. Each guess reveals how closely it is related to the mystery plant on the taxonomic tree — sharing a genus, family, order or higher clade — so you narrow down the plant tree of life to zero in on the answer.

name: Mazele
description: Trace the hidden path across the grid from the left column to the right in as few guesses as possible. Each guess scores every row and column — green for the right number of squares in the right spots, orange for the right count in the wrong spots, black for a wrong count — and you combine those clues to deduce the route.

name: Mahjong Handle
description: Deduce the day's winning Riichi Mahjong hand in 6 guesses. Each guessed hand is scored tile by tile — green for a right tile in the right spot, yellow for a tile that belongs elsewhere, gray for an absent tile — while the round wind, seat wind and win condition shown up top narrow the possibilities.

name: Lyricle
description: Name the song — artist and title — from a single line of its lyrics; each wrong or skipped guess reveals another line, up to 6 attempts.

name: Lordle
description: Guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries; every answer is a word drawn from the text of The Lord of the Rings, with the usual green, yellow and gray letter hints.

name: Locatle
description: Guess the country from a given picture in 6 attempts.

name: Linxicon
description: Connect 2 given words by creating a chain of new words that bridge the gap in their meanings in unlimited attempts.

name: LINKR
description: Draw paths to connect each pair of matching numbered dots, filling the whole grid without crossing lines. 3 puzzles each day.

name: GuessThe.Game
description: Identify the video game from a cropped screenshot; each wrong or skipped guess reveals another screenshot, up to 6.

name: Gram Jam Mini
description: Swap letters to create a 5 letter word in each of the 5 rows in less than 18 moves.

name: Gram Jam
description: Swap letters to create a 6 letter word in each of the 6 rows in less than 20 moves.

name: Globle Capitals
description: Guess the mystery capital city in unlimited number of guesses. The hotter the colour, the closer you are to the mystery capital city.

name: Rotaboxes
description: Rotate the scrambled tiles of a photo until every piece faces the right way and the original picture is restored.

name: Daily Fact or Fiction
description: Guess whether the statement is fact or fiction.

name: Globle
description: Guess a mystery country in unlimited number of guesses. The hotter the colour, the closer you are to the mystery country.

name: Framed
description: Name the movie from a single still frame; each wrong or skipped guess reveals another frame, up to 6.

name: Flipple
description: Change one letter at a time to turn the starting word into the target word, forming a real word at every step. Unlimited attempts.

name: Flickle
description: Watch a short clip and name the movie in 6 tries; each wrong or skipped guess reveals a longer clip.

name: Flagle
description: Guess the country or territory from a flag hidden behind 6 tiles. Each guess reveals another tile and shows the distance, direction, and proximity toward the target — 6 tries.

name: Factle Sports
description: Given a sports-trivia prompt (e.g. the top 5 MLB players by some measure), put the correct 5 answers in the right order. 5 attempts, with feedback after each guess.

name: Factle
description: Given a general-trivia prompt (e.g. the top 5 US states by some measure), put the correct 5 answers in the right order. 5 attempts, with feedback after each guess.

name: Duotrigordle
description: Solve 32 Wordle boards at once, sharing one keyboard. Each guess applies to every unsolved board; you have 37 total guesses to clear all 32.

name: Daydle
description: Guess the 4-digit year a historical event happened on today's date, in 6 tries. Each guess gives a before/after hint and colors the digits Wordle-style — correct, ±1 away, or wrong.

name: Daily Dozen Trivia
description: Answer 9 trivia questions across a 3×3 grid of rotating categories — one guess per square. After all 9, you get one "Double Dip" to retry a single wrong answer.

name: Crosswordle
description: Reverse-engineer a Wordle solve: given the final answer word and the colored tile pattern of the rows above it, fill in letters that would produce exactly those green/yellow/gray clues.

name: Countryle
description: Guess the hidden country with unlimited attempts. Each guess reveals hints — hemisphere, continent, average temperature, population, and the compass direction toward the target.

name: Costcodle
description: Guess the price of a Costco item in 6 tries. Each wrong guess tells you whether the real price is higher or lower and roughly how far off; land within 5% to win.

name: Contexto
description: Guess the hidden word with unlimited attempts. Each guess is ranked by how close it is in meaning to the target — computed by an AI similarity model — with rank 1 being the answer.

name: NYT Connections
description: Find 4 groups of 4 words that share a hidden connection. You get 4 mistakes before the puzzle ends.

name: Colorfle
description: Guess the 3 colors mixed to create the shown swatch, in 6 tries. Correct colors in the right spot turn green, correct colors in the wrong spot turn yellow, and each guess also scores a color-accuracy percentage.

name: Chrono
description: Drag 6 real historical events into chronological order. You get 3 tries to arrange the full sequence correctly.

name: Categories
description: Group 16 words into 4 hidden categories of 4. Wrong guesses cost one of 4 lives; hints and word definitions are available if you're stuck.

name: Calcle
description: Guess the 5 missing numbers in a fixed equation (Ã + + â) so it equals the result shown, in 5 attempts or fewer. Each guess colors correct numbers green (right spot), purple (in the equation, wrong spot), or gray (not used).

name: Byrdle
description: Guess a 6-letter word related to choral music, in 7 tries. Answers can include proper nouns, plurals, and musical terms borrowed from other languages. Standard green/yellow/gray feedback per letter.

name: Box Office Game
description: Guess the top 5 movies in the US domestic box office for a given weekend. Wrong guesses cost one of 10 lives, and you can spend points to reveal hints â tagline, plot, genre, director, cast, budget â for any row.

name: Betweenle
description: Guess a 5-letter word in 14 tries. Each guess only tells you whether the secret word comes alphabetically before or after it, plus roughly how far â narrowing the range until you zero in on it.

name: Bandle
description: Listen to a song built up instrument by instrument, starting with just drums, and guess the title. 6 attempts, with another instrument added each time you're wrong.

name: Squareword
description: Uncover a 5Ã5 grid of letters â every row and column spells a word. Type 5-letter guesses for a row to get green/yellow/gray feedback per letter. Unlimited guesses; fewer is a better score.

name: Quizl
description: Answer 5 multiple-choice trivia questions, each with 4 options, spanning a mix of topics.

name: Flagdle
description: Guess the country from its flag in 6 tries. Each guess shows a percentage of how visually similar its flag is to the target's, based on colors and pattern.

name: Fibble
description: Guess a 5-letter word in 9 tries. Standard green/yellow/gray feedback applies, but exactly one tile in every row is a deliberate lie — the same lie for all players that day.

name: Actorle
description: Guess the featured actor from their filmography — correct guesses reveal the movie's title, genres, and IMDB rating, and an age clue narrows their birth year between two other actors.

name: Absurdle
description: Guess a 5-letter word with unlimited attempts. Unlike Wordle, the hidden word isn't fixed — each guess narrows a pool of possible answers, and the game picks whichever remaining word reveals the least information. Best possible score is 4 guesses.

name: Worldle
description: Guess the country or territory from its outline shape. Each guess shows the distance, direction, and percentage proximity to the target — 6 tries to zero in on it.

name: Nerdle
description: Guess the hidden 8-digit calculation in 6 tries. Each guess must be a valid equation; tiles then turn green (correct spot), purple (correct symbol, wrong spot), or black (not in the solution).

name: Mathler
description: Build a hidden equation using digits 0-9 and +, -, *, / that equals the target number, in 6 tries. Each guess is colored green (correct spot), yellow (right symbol, wrong spot), or gray (not in the equation).

name: Dordle
description: Guess 2 hidden 5-letter words at once. Each guess is checked against both boards, and you get 7 tries total to solve them.

name: Wordle
description: Guess a 5-letter word in 6 tries. Each guess reveals which letters are correct, in the word but misplaced, or absent.
